note: SYNTHETIC. An expired nextPageToken cannot be produced on demand (expiry is roughly seven days and community reports show it is not reliable), so TESTING.md §Fixtures sanctions hand-crafting this one. recordedAt is the fake clock's epoch, not a real moment. The 400-not-410 status and the message substring are what JIRA-API.md documents and what api/search.ts matches on (EXPIRED_TOKEN_MARKER, CC-01); errors is the empty object Jira sends alongside errorMessages. The token in the request is deliberately an obvious placeholder rather than an invented realistic one - the fixture exists to preserve the error shape, not to imitate Atlassian's cursor encoding.

params.jql: project = EX ORDER BY updated DESC

body.jql: project = EX ORDER BY updated DESC

errorMessages: The provided next page token is invalid or expired.
